slot.brief: Give a described observation (e.g. violet colour with iodine, red Cu2O with Tollens'/Fehling's, or osazone formation) and ask which sugar/disaccharide test it corresponds to.

stem: On heating glucose with excess phenylhydrazine, yellow needle-shaped crystals form. This observation identifies which carbohydrate test?

verdicts.working: Glucose reacts with excess phenylhydrazine on heating to form yellow osazone crystals.

working:
Glucose reacts with excess phenylhydrazine to form a yellow crystalline osazone.
The formation of osazone crystals identifies the osazone test.

Independent check: Glucose reacts with excess phenylhydrazine on heating to form yellow osazone crystals.
solution:
On heating, glucose reacts with excess phenylhydrazine to form yellow crystalline osazone.
This characteristic crystal formation identifies the osazone test.
